label: Instagram Feed post
description: Publish one Feed image post to an Instagram professional account linked to a Facebook Page via Graph API after Vault binding and Governor gate

description_i18n.en: Publish one Feed image post to an Instagram professional account via Graph API after Vault binding and Governor gate
description_i18n.zh_CN: 向 Instagram 专业账号发布一张 Feed 图片帖（Graph API；需 Vault 与 Governor）
description_i18n.zh_HK: 向 Instagram 專業帳號發佈一張 Feed 圖片帖（Graph API；需 Vault 與 Governor）

propose_guide: External Instagram Feed post after Internal compose: caption from upstream output. An image is required (JPEG/PNG via image_file_id). Do not share Vault binding with facebook/publish.

propose_guide_i18n.en: External Feed post after compose: caption from upstream. Image required (JPEG/PNG). Do not share Vault with facebook/publish.

propose_guide_i18n.zh_HK: 成文後發 Feed：文案用上游產出。必須有圖（JPEG/PNG）。勿與 facebook/publish 共用 Vault。
